quotes.text: I had an awesome morning with Rocky Mountain Balloon rides. I was really nervous to do this but quickly felt comfortable and had a blast. Jeff has tons of experience and is a fun guy with great stories. We had a smooth take off and landing. Jeff’s your guy for an unforgettable experience!

Jeff was fantastic! Very responsive. I called without even 24 hour notice and he got me on a balloon! You can tell he loves his job and his clients!Would 100% recommend Jeff and his crew! If you’re thinking about it, just do it!!! You won’t regret it!

If I could give more than 5 stars, I would. From beginning to end, my experience with Jeff was enjoyable and effortless. He helped make celebrating my boyfriend’s birthday so special and was flexible with dates when scheduling our ride.
